metadata.title: तूफान के मारों को कब छत नसीब होगी | Cyclone Affected tribals wait for compensation
metadata.description:
On March 23rd, a devastating cyclone wreaked havoc across three districts of Tripura, leaving a trail of destruction in its wake. The ferocity of the cyclone uprooted lives and livelihoods, affecting over a thousand families in its path. As the dust settled and the initial shock subsided, the affected communities found themselves grappling with the harsh reality of their situation.

In the immediate aftermath, the administration swiftly mobilized to provide temporary relief to the affected families. Emergency shelters were set up, essential supplies were distributed, and medical aid was rendered to those in need. Despite these commendable efforts, the road to recovery has been fraught with challenges, especially for the most vulnerable members of society.

Ten days have passed since the cyclone struck, yet many affected families, predominantly comprised of daily wage earners, find themselves in a state of limbo, waiting for much-needed compensation to rebuild their shattered lives. The delay in dispensing compensation has only exacerbated the plight of these families, leaving them in a precarious position with limited resources to sustain themselves.
